About AL IFADA

AL IFADA is the students' union of KANNIYATH USTHAD ISLAMIC ACADEMY, established in 2015. The union brings together literary, cultural, artistic, sporting and student-development activities.

Established2015

Building a student community with purpose and participation.

Current Year2026–27

Main Aimവിദ്യാർത്ഥികളുടെ പുരോഗതി
